body.condition:
There are jointly measurable versions of the two conditional expectations such that
\[
Q\!\left(\left\{\omega:
E_Q[Y_2^Q(d)-Y_1^Q(d)\mid X,Z](\omega)
=E_Q[Y_2^Q(d)-Y_1^Q(d)\mid X](\omega)
\text{ for every }d\in X_0\right\}\right)=1.
\]

novel.justification: de Chaisemartin, D'Haultf\oe{}uille, and Vazquez-Bare (2024) supply the per-dose conditional-parallel-trends condition. The single common full-probability event, together with joint measurability, is an additional strengthening needed to substitute the random diagonal dose \(d=X\). The bounded same-slope lift and the source recession-ray construction both satisfy the stronger equality simultaneously for every dose.
